Well, that one kept pretty low! On a length, probably hits one of the cracks and doesn't bounce. Left alone by Kraigg.
The debutant needs to bowl a stump-to-stump line, percentage stuff is the need of the hour. This one is again wide outside off and the batsman doesn't fiddle with it.
Well outside off, left alone.
Slightly overpitched around off, Brathwaite drives it sweetly but Rajitha shows good reflexes. He dives to his left and stops it.
A hint of away movement from a fullish length but it is way outside off. Kraigg is not bothered by that one.
Hits the deck, outside off and jagging into the batsman who blocks it easily from his crease.
The batsman drives the fuller ball straight down the ground for nothing.
Short of a length, coming into the right-hander, who tucks it to square leg. One run added to the total.
Short delivery and the  batsman ducks under it.
Lakmal dishes this one fuller around off and Brathwaite pushes it to mid on and takes two.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
A heavy off side field in place now. There are only two fielders on the leg side.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Goes around the wicket and fires in a yorker and almost goes under the bat. Smith does well to get his bat down in time and dig it out. Good stuff from the debutant.
Similar delivery from Rajitha and nicely played through the mid-wicket region for another single.
The batsman flicks the length ball to mid-wicket with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Two Leg Byes! Full, on the pads and Smith once again fails to make contact with the ball. The ball hits his pads and goes down to fine leg region. Two runs taken.
Smith defends the good length delivery from within the crease.
Wide! The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. Wide signalled by the umpire.

A loud appeal for an LBW denied! That came in sharply. Nice mix up from the bowler. Keeps it on a good length and brings it in from outside off. Smith is late to get his bat down and is hit on his back pad. Lakmal is jumping in appeal but the umpire isn't interested. The ball goes behind the keeper and a leg bye is taken. Sri Lanka do not opt for the review and the replays suggest it would have been umpire's call as the ball would have clipped the top of the stumps. Doesn't make a difference though.
Too straight and on the pads, the batsman fails to connect with his bat and it hits his pads.
Similar length, outside off, Smith gets his bat up and lets it go to the keeper.
Change of angle, goes around the wicket to bring the ball in to the left-hander. Lands it on a fullish length around off and makes the batsman play. Good intelligent stuff from Lakmal.
Outside off and left alone on length by the batsman.
Gets behind the shortish delivery and punches it down the pitch.
Full and on the legs, the batsman clips it to square leg and takes a single.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
OOH! Uppish! Not too convincing from Smith. Gets a fuller delivery around off and pushes at it. The ball hits the outer half and almost flies to the point fielder.
Another leave to the ball outside off. Nice and watchful stuff from Devon.
Similar delivery, touch too wide. The batsman shoulders his arms.
Angling away from the left-hander and on full length, Smith gets his hands up and lets it pass.
Similar length but touch too wide to entice the batsman. No run to end the over.
Full and outside off, Brathwaite leaves it on length.
Wide and swinging away and ignored by the batsman.
Drags his length back and keeps it around off. Brathwaite blocks it tentatively to the off side.
Full and between the sticks, the batsman presents the full face of the bat.
Back of a length on the pads, clipped to the vacant square leg region for a single.
Straight outside off and Brathwaite keeps his willow away from the ball. A maiden over to start his career.
Goes full but down the leg side. Keeper collects it neatly.
Touch too wide and left alone.
On a good length around off and punched off the back foot.
Full and outside off and almost an edge. The batsman hangs his bat but fails to make connection.
Starts his Test career with a short of a length delivery, angling into the batsman, who dabs it to mid-wicket.
The debutant, Kasun Rajitha comes into the attack. He will be aiming to put in an impressive performance.
Ends the over with a back of a length delivery on the hips and the batsman plays it down to the leg side with soft hands.
Little bit of shape, into Smith, off the good length and hits his pads.
Full around off, blocked by the left-hander.
Leg Bye! Too straight, back of a length and the batsman misses and gets hits on his thigh pad. The batsmen pinch a run.
Similar length, outside off and fended off the back foot.
Starts with a good length delivery and on the stumps. Brathwaite blocks it.
We are set to get underway. Kraigg Brathwaite and Devon Smith to continue their batting. Suranga Lakmal to bowl first up this morning. Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold assessing the surface says that the batsmen need to make use of the scoring opportunities whenever they come by. States that the shorter lengths had worked for the hosts and Sri Lanka will be aiming to hit those areas as well.

Kemar Roach is being interviewed by Darren Ganga on the sidelines. He says that it was a tough start for him but he was just trying to bowl it on line and length and that worked for him. Further adds that he is pleased with his 150th Test wicket. While talking about being 30 years old now and still playing the longest format, he states that in the start of his career he was fitter and aggressive but now he is enjoying the game more. Ends by saying that to get back in the side and lead the bowling attack is really good for him and he is enjoying it more.

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, would like their bowlers to inspire something special. They would like them to use the greenish top to their advantage, and make full use of the wind blowing across the square as well. Suranga Lakmal, their most experienced bowler, needs to come good. New ball can prove to be handy, if utilized properly. Should be an exciting contest, stay tuned for the live action...

Hello and welcome to the coverage of 2nd day of the second Test match between West Indies and Sri Lanka from St Lucia. After yesterday's exploits, the Windies will be looking to enhance their dominance. Their bowlers have done a commendable job to bowl out Sri Lanka for just over 250. And it's time for their batters to come good and take the game away from the visitors.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

The visitors were hoping for a better start to the second Test but it wasn't to be. Apart from Chandimal and Mendis to an extent, the other batsmen didn't show proper resistance. The Sri Lankan skipper scored a classy century on a demanding pitch and has given his side something to battle for. Day 2 promises to be good for the batting side but the Lankan bowlers can make things interesting by replicating their opposition's tactics. Join us on Friday at 1000 local (1400 GMT) to catch all the action. Till then, cheers!

Safely negotiated. The opening pair of the hosts required only a couple of overs to survive and they have done just that before the close of play. Earlier, it was a dominant display from the Windies' fast bowlers throughout the day. They were asked to bowl first on a green top and they made full use of the helpful conditions. Shannon Gabriel took a fifer and Kemar Roach complemented him equally well with a 4-wicket haul. The other bowlers were disciplined as well and kept a leash on the Sri Lankan batsmen.
Smith gets forward and defends the flighted delivery. THAT IS STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Tossed up on middle and leg, Smith goes back in his crease and blocks it from the full face of the bat.
Another loopy delivery and almost a yorker. The batsman digs it out.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads outside leg.
Tossed up on middle and blocked off the back foot by Smith.
Flighted on off and driven off the front foot to mid on for nothing.
Akila Dananjaya to share the new ball from the other end.
Touch fuller but too wide to make Brathwaite play at it.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
In that same channel once again and the right-hander stays away from the delivery.
Similar length around off, left alone by the batsman.
Too straight and down the leg side, the batsman lets it pass to the keeper.
West Indies are away! Lakmal starts with a short of a length delivery and Brathwaite tucks it away off his pads for a couple.
